title: Marketplace documentation structure — design
summary: Design for splitting marketplace-level and plugin-level documentation, per-plugin changelogs, plugin template skeleton, and pre-commit hook routing changes.
notes: Path convention (specs/) is a strong SPEC signal and content defines structural contracts (file layout, hook rules, commit sequence). Also contains an ADR-like 'Status: approved' and a Decisions table, but no ADR filename/frontmatter convention; ambiguity resolved toward SPEC per directory convention. Contains no code schemas or APIs, hence medium confidence.
